core_capabilities: Create an expense-report draft with employee, cost-centre, currency, template, application, budget, and purpose details, then save, cancel, or resume it.
Enter, edit, duplicate, and remove receipt-based and per-diem expense lines with dates, amounts, expense types, destinations, descriptions, and reimbursement details.
Assign accounting dimensions to expense and per-diem lines, save the allocations, and validate them against the expected natural account, analysis, budget holder, cost centre, and fund source.
Select report approvers and upload or remove permitted Word-document proof attachments.
Submit an in-app report snapshot containing its calculated total, expense lines, allocations, approvers, and attachments after required proof is present.
secondary_capabilities: Track submitted reports, open their saved report details, and withdraw eligible submitted reports from the expense home page.

app.description: Prepare, allocate, review, and submit in-app employee expense reports.

tasks.appDescription: Expenseflow: an expense-management app with a FastAPI backend (in-memory per-visitor state) and a Vite/React frontend.
